notes: Official run_all.py loads images/ with -r -1 (width 1600) -> mipnerf360-1600. --steps must be 30000: the mask-loss window (19000..20000), mask_prune cadence (>=15000, every 1000) and the final single-sample keep (step == total_steps 30000) use absolute steps.
